description: This file is a CMake script (cmake module) that monitors the state of a git repository. It defines functions and macros to check git status, detect changes, and trigger reconfiguration when the repository's state changes. The script is intended to be used within a build system to ensure build consistency with the current git repository state.

methods.name: RunGitCommand
methods.description: Executes a git command via execute_process, setting environment variables based on the command's success and output.

methods.name: GetGitState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the git repository, including commit hash, author, date, and status (dirty or clean).

methods.name: GitStateChangedAction
methods.description: Triggered when the git repository state changes. It updates the configuration files based on current git info.

methods.name: HashGitState
methods.description: Computes a SHA256 hash from the current git state variables for change detection.

methods.name: CheckGit
methods.description: Checks if the git repository has changed by comparing current state hash to stored hash.

methods.name: SetupGitMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up a build target to check git status before building, triggering configuration update if needed.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Primary entry point, executing either the git check or setting up monitoring based on context.
